description: This file defines interfaces for delta encoding, including functions to create, free, and manipulate delta indices and delta data between buffers. It provides functions for creating delta indices, generating deltas, applying patches, and related utilities.

methods.name: create_delta_index
methods.description: Compute index data from a given buffer for delta operations.

methods.name: free_delta_index
methods.description: Free the index created by create_delta_index.

methods.name: sizeof_delta_index
methods.description: Return the memory usage of a delta index.

methods.name: create_delta
methods.description: Create a delta from the index for a given buffer, possibly limited by max_delta_size.

methods.name: void * diff_delta(const void * src_buf,unsigned long src_bufsize,const void * trg_buf,unsigned long trg_bufsize,unsigned long * delta_size,unsigned long max_delta_size)
methods.description: Create a delta representing the difference between source and target buffers.

methods.name: patch_delta
methods.description: Recreate the target buffer from a source buffer and delta data.

methods.name: unsigned long get_delta_hdr_size(const unsigned char ** datap,const unsigned char * top)
methods.description: Extract the expected size from delta data buffer header.

ctags.name: diff_delta
ctags.signature: (const void * src_buf,unsigned long src_bufsize,const void * trg_buf,unsigned long trg_bufsize,unsigned long * delta_size,unsigned long max_delta_size)

ctags.name: get_delta_hdr_size
ctags.pattern: /^static inline unsigned long get_delta_hdr_size(const unsigned char **datap,$/
ctags.signature: (const unsigned char ** datap,const unsigned char * top)
